info.name: Conduct an audit Auditors Vulnerabilities API
info.description:
The Auditor API lets audit firms conduct audits from a tool outside of Vanta. Unlock data syncing with Vanta through this API.

Contact Support:
 Name: API Support
 Email: support@vanta.com
